import numpy as np
X=np.arange(20).reshape(10,2)
y=np.arange(10)
def batches(X,y,size,rng):
    positions=rng.permutation(len(X))
    for start in range(0,len(X),size):
        ix=positions[start:start+size]
        yield X[ix],y[ix]
parts=list(batches(X,y,4,np.random.default_rng(0)))
sizes=[len(xb) for xb,yb in parts]
covered=bool(np.array_equal(np.sort(np.concatenate([yb for xb,yb in parts])),y))
